centre.description: The farthest planet from the Sun, a blue ice giant with the fastest winds known and faint dark rings.
knownLimitations: Neptune's picture is a Solar System Scope map (CC BY 4.0) based on NASA imagery; its clouds are a stand-in, not a view of any one day.
The surface drawn is the 1-bar cloud-top level, not a solid surface.
The rings are drawn as flat bands in Planetary Explorer's colours; a ring narrower than the picture can show is drawn wider than it is. Brightness is a look, not a measurement.

mapped.description: Neptune's largest moon, orbiting backwards, with nitrogen geysers and a surface of frozen nitrogen.
